order: Execution Order: Entry-State Indicator (2 October 2026), section 3

universe.source: data/universe.txt at commit 7cc7e4c (the union universe on 2 Oct 2026), frozen here
universe.limitation: survivorship: today's members only; names delisted before 2 Oct 2026 are absent, which biases levels upward for every contestant alike

window.entries_to: the last completed session at run time less the horizon
window.prices: yfinance daily OHLC, auto_adjust=False: split-adjusted open/high/low/close drive the states (ratio-invariant, as charted live); adjusted closes (dividends) scale opens and lows for returns and excursions

costs.applied: 10 bps on entry and 10 bps on exit of the name; the SPY benchmark is costless

execution.signal: the state at the close of session t
execution.horizon_h: exit at the close of session t+h (session t+1 is the first session held)

contestants.READY: sessions graded READY or READY-HALF (trigger sessions; the event gate changes size, not the entry)
contestants.SETUP_ONLY: the first session of each WATCH spell (setup present, no trigger)
contestants.BASELINE: names passing the trend gate at the close of each month's last session, entered at the open of the next month's first session

metrics.X20: name total return t+1 open -> t+20 close, less SPY over the same sessions, less 20 bps
metrics.MAE20: max(0, -min over sessions t+1..t+20 of adjusted low / adjusted entry open - 1)
metrics.STOP20: 1 if any close in t+1..t+20 is below the stop of session t (READY: the armed stop; others: the stop formula at t), else 0

pairing.rule: both contestants are restricted to the tickers that have at least one entry in each over the window; every entry of those tickers counts; there is no matching of entries to each other

statistics.dMAE: median MAE20 over the contestant's entries minus the median MAE20 over BASELINE's entries (common names)
statistics.dX60: mean X60 over the contestant's entries minus the mean over BASELINE's entries (common names)

bootstrap.blocks: entry months: the distinct entry months of the two contestants are resampled with replacement, and each drawn month brings all entries of BOTH contestants in that month, so the two are compared on the same resampled history (paired at the resample level)

decision_rule.PASS: the 90 percent interval of dMAE lies entirely below zero AND the lower bound of the 90 percent interval of dX60 is at least -0.010

power_check.pair: SETUP_ONLY vs BASELINE, the v2 construction, same seed, run and reported before READY is evaluated
power_check.has_power: the dMAE interval half-width is at most 0.0025 AND the dX60 interval half-width is at most 0.010
power_check.also_reported: the rule's outcome on that pair (does its dMAE interval exclude zero, in which direction)
power_check.if_no_power: READY is still computed and its full distributions reported, but the verdict is NO VERDICT (rule lacks power); a new registration is required

label_consequence: the badge stays DIAGNOSTIC on FAIL and on NO VERDICT; on PASS the operator decides whether to lift it (the referee's entry:diagnostic_gate requires verdict PASS in data/entry_state_validation.json before any other label)

expected_result.READY_vs_BASELINE: FAIL. READY entries follow a pullback and a one-session turn; volatility clusters, so the excursion over the next 20 sessions should be about the same as or larger than at a month-start entry: dMAE expected between 0 and +0.5 percentage points, its interval not entirely below zero (condition a fails); dX60 within plus or minus 1 point (condition b holds).
expected_result.SETUP_ONLY_vs_BASELINE: dMAE about +0.15 point (the unconditional difference already visible in the v1 output, disclosed above); its interval may include zero. Whether the half-widths meet the power thresholds (0.25 and 1.0 point) is uncertain: entries now differ in their months (setups cluster in sell-offs), which widens a difference of medians under month resampling.

artifacts.price_history: scratch/entry_validation/ (git-ignored; the v1 fetch is reused; its sha256 is recorded in every result)

do_not_touch: nothing above changes once a run begins; a change requires a new registration with a stated reason, and both results are reported

supersedes.reason: v1 paired the contestants on common (entry month, ticker) cells; a later entry in the same month implies a pullback after the month-start baseline entry, so the paired baseline was conditioned on the future (median MAE20 5.32% vs 2.30% in the other cells; reports/entry_state_power_check_2026-10-02.md). v2 returns to the order's wording: common names, every entry, months resampled jointly.

seen_before_registration: the v1 power-check output: SETUP_ONLY and BASELINE entry counts, unconditional distributions and the v1 paired statistics (data/entry_state_power_check.json); the READY entry count (16,949). No READY return, excursion or stop-out figure was computed for a report or seen.
